evidence: The thickness of the films was measured by and ex situ ellipsometer (FS-1, Film-Sense, USA). To observe the interface between the AlN film and the substrate, cross-sections were prepared using a focused ion beam (FIB; Nova 200, FRI, Netherlands), and imaging was performed using a high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM; JEM-2100F, JEOL, Japan). The elemental mapping was confirmed by energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) in combination with a scanning TEM (data not shown).
